items.title: Updates install while you work
items.text: Updates arrive with plain dnf, in the background, once a day. Only a new kernel, graphics driver or firmware asks for a restart, when you like.

items.title: Colours follow every wallpaper
items.text: Arctic’s own photos now colour the desktop too, and automatic wallpaper rotation recolours it with each picture.

items.title: One passphrase at start-up
items.text: When updates are installed at start-up, Arctic goes straight on to the login screen with the disk still unlocked.

items.title: Voice typing with OpenWhispr
items.text: Install OpenWhispr from Settings → Voice typing, then press Super + Ctrl + X to open it and speak into any app.

items.title: Lighter everyday apps
items.text: Epiphany, Foot, PCManFM, XArchiver, Celluloid and FeatherPad keep the default desktop quick and focused.

items.title: Desktop polish
items.text: The bar, lock screen, battery-full icon, wallpaper controls and app menus have received reliability and visual fixes.
